meta.title: BhaivaTech Storefront Core validation
meta.author: BhaivaTech
meta.description: Disposable WordPress Playground environment for the Modern Grocery alpha.

options.blogdescription: Fast everyday baskets, built on WooCommerce.

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

update_option( 'bhaivatech_storefront_delivery_postcodes', "560001\n560034\n560038", false );

if ( function_exists( 'wc_get_page_id' ) ) {
    $page_ids = array();
    $pages = array(
        'shop' => array( 'title' => 'Shop', 'content' => '[woocommerce_product_search]\n[woocommerce_all_products]' ),
        'cart' => array( 'title' => 'Cart', 'content' => '<!-- wp:woocommerce/cart /-->' ),
        'checkout' => array( 'title' => 'Checkout', 'content' => '<!-- wp:woocommerce/checkout /-->' ),
        'myaccount' => array( 'title' => 'My account', 'content' => '[bhaivatech_shopping_list]\n[bhaivatech_buy_again]' )
    );
    foreach ( $pages as $key => $page ) {
        $existing = get_page_by_title( $page['title'], OBJECT, 'page' );
        $page_ids[ $key ] = $existing ? $existing->ID : wp_insert_post( array( 'post_title' => $page['title'], 'post_content' => $page['content'], 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_type' => 'page' ) );
    }
    update_option( 'woocommerce_shop_page_id', $page_ids['shop'] );
    update_option( 'woocommerce_cart_page_id', $page_ids['cart'] );
    update_option( 'woocommerce_checkout_page_id', $page_ids['checkout'] );
    update_option( 'woocommerce_myaccount_page_id', $page_ids['myaccount'] );
}

$products = array(
    array( 'name' => 'Fresh Tomatoes', 'price' => '42', 'category' => 'Produce' ),
    array( 'name' => 'Whole Milk', 'price' => '68', 'category' => 'Dairy' ),
    array( 'name' => 'Sourdough Bread', 'price' => '95', 'category' => 'Bakery' ),
    array( 'name' => 'Basmati Rice', 'price' => '249', 'category' => 'Pantry' ),
    array( 'name' => 'Free Range Eggs', 'price' => '120', 'category' => 'Dairy' ),
    array( 'name' => 'Banana Robusta', 'price' => '55', 'category' => 'Produce' )
);
foreach ( $products as $item ) {
    if ( get_page_by_title( $item['name'], OBJECT, 'product' ) ) {
        continue;
    }
    $product = new WC_Product_Simple();
    $product->set_name( $item['name'] );
    $product->set_status( 'publish' );
    $product->set_catalog_visibility( 'visible' );
    $product->set_regular_price( $item['price'] );
    $product->set_stock_status( 'instock' );
    $product_id = $product->save();
    $term = term_exists( $item['category'], 'product_cat' );
    $term_id = $term ? (int) $term['term_id'] : wp_insert_term( $item['category'], 'product_cat' )['term_id'];
    wp_set_object_terms( $product_id, array( $term_id ), 'product_cat' );
}

<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$zone = new WC_Shipping_Zone();
$zone->set_zone_name( 'Bengaluru validation zone' );
$zone->save();
foreach ( array( '560001', '560034', '560038' ) as $postcode ) {
    $zone->add_location( $postcode, 'postcode' );
}
$zone->save();
